articles.title: Viral Video Shows Elderly Father Allegedly Beaten by Son and Daughter-in-Law in Goa; Son Arrested
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A viral video allegedly showing an 83-year-old man being assaulted by his son and daughter-in-law has led to the arrest of one accused in Goa's Colva.

body.html:
A viral video allegedly showing an 83-year-old man being assaulted by his son and daughter-in-law has led to the arrest of one accused in Goa's Colva.

Colva Police arrested Isidoreo Souza, a resident of Betalbatim, on Friday under various provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) and the Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act, 2007, for allegedly assaulting his 83-year-old father, Loyala Souza.

Police said Isidoreo's wife, Irene Gonsalves, has also been booked in the case. However, she was not arrested at the time of registration of the FIR in view of Supreme Court guidelines.

The case was registered based on a complaint filed by Crisostomo Mariano Soares of Cuncolim, who told police he came across a viral video on social media showing an elderly man being assaulted inside a house.

According to the complaint, the video allegedly shows Irene slapping the senior citizen and beating him with slippers. Isidoreo is also seen allegedly assaulting his father with slaps and punches. The complainant further alleged that the couple abused, threatened and humiliated the elderly man and prevented him from leaving the house.

Police said the complaint prima facie discloses offences including physical assault, wrongful restraint, wrongful confinement and criminal intimidation.

Based on the complaint, Colva Police registered a case against both accused for allegedly assaulting the elderly man with common intention, causing bodily injuries, abusing him with filthy language and threatening him with dire consequences.

Goa Director of Social Welfare Dipak Desai said he forwarded the viral video to the Director General of Police, seeking an investigation and appropriate legal action based on the available evidence.

Further investigation is underway.

#Goa #ElderAbuse #ViralVideo #Crime #SeniorCitizens

articles.title: Kanwariyas Clash with Police in Muzaffarnagar, Cops and Journalists Allegedly Manhandled
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Tension prevailed in Uttar Pradesh's Muzaffarnagar on Friday night after a group of Kanwariyas allegedly manhandled police personnel and misbehaved with journalists during a dispute over safety measures taken during the Kanwar Yatra.

body.html:
Tension prevailed in Uttar Pradesh's Muzaffarnagar on Friday night after a group of Kanwariyas allegedly manhandled police personnel and misbehaved with journalists during a dispute over safety measures taken during the Kanwar Yatra.

According to police, the incident occurred at around 10 pm near Shiv Chowk in the Kotwali police station area, where more than 50 Kanwariyas travelling from Haridwar to Ghaziabad had stopped to perform the customary parikrama.

Officials said some Kanwariyas climbed onto the roof of a double-decker DJ Kanwar while an 11,000-volt power line passed overhead. Concerned about the risk of electrocution, Kotwali Station House Officer Brijesh Sharma asked them to get down.

The request allegedly led to an argument, with some Kanwariyas becoming abusive. During the altercation, one of the participants allegedly threatened the officer, saying, "If you're too proud of your uniform, I'll have it removed in five minutes."

After completing the parikrama, a group of Kanwariyas staged a sit-in protest at Shiv Chowk, demanding an apology from the police officer. City Superintendent of Police Siddharth K. Mishra reached the spot along with additional police personnel and attempted to calm the situation.

During the commotion, some Kanwariyas allegedly pushed and misbehaved with police personnel. Journalists covering the incident were also allegedly manhandled and shoved, with some sustaining minor injuries.

Police personnel continued to appeal to the crowd to maintain peace. The protest ended after senior officers persuaded the Kanwariyas to resume their journey.

Police said they are identifying those involved in the incident using viral videos and other evidence. A complaint has also been lodged by a journalist against two named individuals and 15 unidentified persons.

An investigation is underway, and police said appropriate legal action will be taken against those found responsible for obstructing public servants and disrupting law and order.

#UttarPradesh #Muzaffarnagar #KanwarYatra #Kanwariya #Police

articles.title: Woman Dragged by Hair, Assaulted on Gorakhpur Road After Minor Crash; Attempt to Murder Charge Added
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A case of alleged road rage and assault has come to light in Uttar Pradesh's Gorakhpur, where a 24-year-old woman was allegedly dragged out of her car by her hair, beaten, and threatened after refusing to apologise following a minor collision with a motorcycle.

body.html:
A case of alleged road rage and assault has come to light in Uttar Pradesh's Gorakhpur, where a 24-year-old woman was allegedly dragged out of her car by her hair, beaten, and threatened after refusing to apologise following a minor collision with a motorcycle.

According to police, the incident occurred at around 6.30 pm on July 9 near the Railway Hospital in the Shahpur police station area. Shivangi Shukla, a resident of Rail Vihar Colony, was taking her father to the hospital in her Grand Vitara when her car allegedly collided with a motorcycle ridden by Subhash Nishad, a resident of Mohanpur.

Police said the biker allegedly demanded that the woman apologise. When she refused, he reportedly called several associates, who arrived in a black Scorpio SUV. The group allegedly vandalised her car, dragged her out by her hair and assaulted her in the middle of the road.

In her complaint, the woman alleged that the accused beat her, attempted to tear her clothes, touched her inappropriately, and threatened to rape and kill her. She also alleged that the attackers damaged her car by smashing its windows.

The victim's father, who was in the car at the time and was being taken to the hospital for treatment, allegedly tried to intervene but was unable to stop the assault. Local residents rushed to the spot after hearing the commotion, following which the accused fled.

The woman alerted Dial 112 and Shahpur Police. Officers reached the scene, shifted the damaged vehicle to the police station and registered an FIR based on her complaint.

A video purportedly showing the assault has since surfaced on social media. Following the emergence of the footage, police added more serious charges to the case, including attempt to murder, outraging the modesty of a woman, assault and property damage.

Late on Friday, police arrested one accused, Raj Nishad, a resident of Mohanpur in Padri Bazaar. Efforts are underway to identify and arrest the remaining accused using CCTV footage, vehicle registration details and other evidence.

Circle Officer Gorakhnath Ravi Singh said further legal action will be taken based on the findings of the investigation, which has been entrusted to Sub-Inspector Durgesh Nandani.

#UttarPradesh #Gorakhpur #RoadRage #WomenSafety #Crime

articles.title: UP Headmistress Hits Student's Guardian with Shoe Over Transfer Certificate Dispute, Probe Ordered
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video showing a government primary school headmistress allegedly hitting a student's guardian with her shoe in Uttar Pradesh's Kaushambi district has gone viral on social media, prompting the education department to order an inquiry.

body.html:
A video showing a government primary school headmistress allegedly hitting a student's guardian with her shoe in Uttar Pradesh's Kaushambi district has gone viral on social media, prompting the education department to order an inquiry.

The 34-second video, reportedly recorded at Tika Ka Pura Primary School in the Muratganj block, shows headmistress Anita Devi repeatedly striking the guardian following an argument over the issuance of a Transfer Certificate (TC).

According to reports, the dispute began when the student's guardian, identified as Anuj, visited the school to obtain a Transfer Certificate for the child. The headmistress allegedly insisted that the child and the Aadhaar card be brought to the school before the certificate could be issued. The guardian maintained that he had already submitted the Aadhaar card, leading to a heated verbal exchange.

The viral video shows the argument escalating as another person records the incident on a mobile phone. During the confrontation, the guardian is heard saying that the Aadhaar card had already been submitted, while the person filming sarcastically encourages the headmistress to continue and remarks that the incident is being recorded.

Reports suggest the headmistress became upset after noticing that the altercation was being filmed. She allegedly snatched the guardian's mobile phone and threw it to the ground. As the man attempted to retrieve the device, a scuffle reportedly broke out, during which the headmistress fell. She then allegedly removed her footwear and repeatedly struck the guardian in front of bystanders.

Basic Education Officer Kamlendra Kushwaha confirmed that the viral video was recorded at Tika Ka Pura Primary School in Muratganj block and said the matter has been referred to the Block Education Officer for an inquiry.

He said both parties later visited the local police station, where they reportedly reached a mutual understanding. However, authorities are awaiting the inquiry report, after which further action, if required, will be taken.

#UttarPradesh #Kaushambi #ViralVideo #School #Education

articles.title: Railway Gatekeeper Risks His Life to Save Man from Oncoming Train
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A railway gatekeeper displayed remarkable courage by rescuing a man from the tracks just moments before an approaching passenger train reached him near Arasur in Tamil Nadu's Sirkazhi. The dramatic rescue, captured on CCTV, has gone viral on social media.

body.html:
A railway gatekeeper displayed remarkable courage by rescuing a man from the tracks just moments before an approaching passenger train reached him near Arasur in Tamil Nadu's Sirkazhi. The dramatic rescue, captured on CCTV, has gone viral on social media.

The incident occurred at around 4.30 pm on Monday at Level Crossing Gate No. 214, where 30-year-old Sandeep Chahar, a railway gatekeeper from Jaipur, was on duty. Chahar has been serving in Mayiladuthurai district for the past seven years.

According to railway officials, a middle-aged man, allegedly under the influence of alcohol, ducked beneath the closed railway gate and attempted to cross the tracks as a passenger train travelling from Mayiladuthurai to Villupuram approached.

Realising the imminent danger, Chahar ran onto the tracks and pulled the man to safety just seconds before the train passed.

Recalling the incident, Chahar said he was frightened but believed it was his duty to protect both the public and railway operations. He added that after rescuing the man, he was briefly overwhelmed by the incident.

The Railway Protection Force (RPF) said the identity of the rescued man has not yet been established.

Southern Railway's Tiruchy Division has announced that Chahar will be honoured for his bravery. Officials said this was the first such life-threatening rescue he had encountered during his seven years of service.

#TamilNadu #Sirkazhi #IndianRailways #CCTV #Hero #Railway #BreakingNews

articles.title: NBSTC Bus Runs Over Pedestrian After Suspected Mechanical Failure, Driver and Conductor Flee
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A man was killed after being crushed under the wheels of a North Bengal State Transport Corporation (NBSTC) bus at Bihar More in Bagdogra on Friday. The incident triggered panic among local residents.

body.html:
A man was killed after being crushed under the wheels of a North Bengal State Transport Corporation (NBSTC) bus at Bihar More in Bagdogra on Friday. The incident triggered panic among local residents.

According to reports, the NBSTC bus was travelling from Islampur to Siliguri when it allegedly developed a mechanical fault near the entrance of Bagdogra Bihar More.

Police said a loud sound was heard from the bus, following which the driver reportedly lost control and the vehicle began moving erratically.

While taking a turn at Bihar More, the bus allegedly hit a pedestrian crossing the road before crashing into a flyover pillar. The victim died on the spot.

Several passengers on board the bus also sustained injuries in the accident. The identity of the deceased has not yet been established.

After receiving information, personnel from Bagdogra Police Station and the Bagdogra Traffic Guard reached the spot. The body was recovered and sent to North Bengal Medical College and Hospital (NBMCH) for post-mortem examination.

The damaged bus was later removed from the scene with the help of a crane and taken to the police station. The driver and conductor reportedly fled after the accident.

Police have registered a case and launched an investigation into the incident.

#WestBengal #Bagdogra #RoadAccident #NBSTC #BreakingNews

articles.title: Speeding Scorpio Goes Out of Control, Smashes Parked Car and House Gate in Agra
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A speeding SUV caused a major accident in Subhash Nagar, Agra, on Wednesday after the driver allegedly lost control of the vehicle. The Scorpio first rammed into a parked car before crashing through the gate of a nearby house and slamming into its boundary wall.

body.html:
A speeding SUV caused a major accident in Subhash Nagar, Agra, on Wednesday after the driver allegedly lost control of the vehicle.

The Scorpio first rammed into a parked car before crashing through the gate of a nearby house and slamming into its boundary wall. The entire incident was captured on a nearby CCTV camera.

Fortunately, no one was near the parked vehicle when the crash occurred, and no injuries were reported.

Police said they are using the vehicle's registration number to identify and trace the driver involved in the incident.

A case has been registered, and further investigation is underway to ascertain the cause of the accident.

#UttarPradesh #Agra #RoadAccident #CCTV #BreakingNews

articles.title: Inter-Caste Bride Allegedly Abducted Days After Wedding, CCTV Captures Dramatic Incident
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A newlywed woman was allegedly abducted by her relatives from her husband's house in Telangana's Medak district, just days after an inter-caste marriage, prompting a police investigation.

body.html:
A newlywed woman was allegedly abducted by her relatives from her husband's house in Telangana's Medak district, just days after an inter-caste marriage, prompting a police investigation.

Pranay, a resident of Ellapur village in Papannapet mandal, married the woman from Salabatpur village in Kowdipalli mandal on July 6. As both were adults but belonged to different castes, they had approached the police following objections from the bride's family.

After counselling both families, police allowed the couple to live together, with the woman reportedly stating that she wished to stay with her husband.

According to Pranay's mother, Shyamala, the bride's relatives initially created a ruckus over the inter-caste marriage. Two days later, they allegedly arrived at the family's residence in four cars. Finding most family members away, they allegedly pushed Shyamala aside, threatened those present and forcibly took the woman away.

The incident was captured on CCTV cameras, and the footage later went viral on social media.

Pranay's family lodged a complaint with the Papannapet Police, alleging that no immediate action was taken. Police subsequently registered a case under Section 137 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) against three members of the woman's family and launched an investigation to trace her and ascertain her wishes.

According to police, both families were later counselled, after which the woman was sent back to Pranay's residence. Police did not disclose her identity, citing the sensitive nature of the case.

Officials said legal action would be taken if it is established that the woman was taken away against her will.

#Telangana #Medak #InterCasteMarriage #Kidnapping #CCTV

articles.title: CCTV Captures Schoolchild Falling from Moving Van in Bhilai, Major Tragedy Narrowly Averted
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A major tragedy was narrowly averted in Chhattisgarh's Bhilai after a schoolchild fell from a moving school van on Nandini Road in the Cantonment police station area. The entire incident was captured on a nearby CCTV camera.

body.html:
A major tragedy was narrowly averted in Chhattisgarh's Bhilai after a schoolchild fell from a moving school van on Nandini Road in the Cantonment police station area. The entire incident was captured on a nearby CCTV camera.

According to reports, the incident occurred at around 1.30 pm on July 8. A van belonging to Forbells School in Khursipar was dropping students at their homes. Shortly after dropping off one child and moving about 10 metres ahead, another child seated in the rear of the van reportedly lost balance and fell onto the road.

CCTV footage shows the child falling from the rear gate of the moving van and rolling onto the road. Fortunately, there was no speeding heavy vehicle behind the van, and the car following it was moving slowly, preventing a potentially fatal accident.

Local residents and nearby shopkeepers rushed to help the injured child. A shopkeeper picked up the child from the road and provided immediate assistance. The child sustained facial injuries.

According to eyewitnesses, the rear gate of the van was allegedly not properly locked after another student had been dropped off. They claimed the driver accelerated without securing the gate, causing the child to fall.

After the incident, nearby shopkeepers shouted at the driver to stop, but the van reportedly continued for nearly 300 metres before bikers chased it down and forced it to halt. A woman who had come to receive her child later accompanied the injured child.

Eyewitnesses also alleged that there was no conductor or attendant in the school van, with only the driver present to supervise the children.

The incident has raised serious concerns over the safety of school transport and compliance with child safety norms. However, no police case has been registered so far, as the child's family has not lodged a complaint.

#Chhattisgarh #Bhilai #SchoolVan #CCTV #ChildSafety

articles.title: Supreme Court Drama: Petitioner Throws Papers, Abuses CJI During Hearing; Escorted Out by Security
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: High drama unfolded in the Supreme Court on Friday when a petitioner appearing in person allegedly threw case papers in the courtroom, used abusive language against the Chief Justice of India and disrupted proceedings before being escorted out by security personnel.

body.html:
High drama unfolded in the Supreme Court on Friday when a petitioner appearing in person allegedly threw case papers in the courtroom, used abusive language against the Chief Justice of India and disrupted proceedings before being escorted out by security personnel.

The incident occurred during the hearing of a Special Leave Petition filed by Prabal Pratap before a partial working-day Bench of Justices KV Viswanathan and Alok Aradhe.

Pratap had approached the Supreme Court after the Allahabad High Court dismissed his plea challenging the conversion of his application under Section 173(4) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) into a private complaint instead of directing the registration of an FIR.

When the matter was taken up, the petitioner introduced himself as "the sovereign" and addressed the judges as "judicial servants". He told the Bench, "Mr Judicial Servant, I order you to order the registration of an FIR against the ASP, Lucknow."

Justice K.V. Viswanathan responded, "You are ordering me? You are ordering us?"

Moments later, the petitioner allegedly hurled case papers inside the courtroom and used abusive language against the Chief Justice of India. Supreme Court security personnel immediately intervened, restrained him and escorted him out of the courtroom.

Despite the disruption, the Bench maintained composure and continued hearing the remaining matters on the day's cause list. The Court also decided not to initiate contempt or any other coercive proceedings against the petitioner.

In its order, the Bench observed, "Considering the condition of the petitioner, we do not propose to take any action against him. As far as the merits of the case are concerned, we have perused the records and find no good grounds to interfere with the impugned order." The Special Leave Petition was accordingly dismissed.

Justice Viswanathan later remarked, "He is very disturbed... it's all frustration. We only have sympathies for him."

Following the incident, the Supreme Court Arguing Counsel Association wrote to Chief Justice Surya Kant, seeking strict action to protect the dignity of the institution. The association also expressed concern over the selective circulation of courtroom videos by certain YouTube channels, social media accounts and self-styled journalists, alleging that such content could undermine public confidence in the judiciary.

The petitioner had challenged an Allahabad High Court order that directed him to pursue his grievance as a private complaint before the trial court instead of seeking registration of an FIR. The Supreme Court found no reason to interfere with the High Court's decision and dismissed the petition.

#SupremeCourt #Judiciary #BreakingNews #Courtroom #India
